objective: Implement the accepted ADR-0012 transfer lifecycle as a versioned CareOps ledger on one deterministic scheduler, with explicit claims, logical idempotency, compensation, deadline handling and supported checkpoint/restart.
steps: Add versioned typed identities, transfer envelopes, monotone operation revisions and deterministic per-operation message deduplication/pending replay.

Implement the full accepted state graph with unique location and responsibility, exclusive resource claims, deadline processing before same-tick commands, and explicit origin/destination claim conversion/release.
Implement post-departure rejection as a linked compensating operation without duplicating the person or episode; settle ownership and claims at the compensating handover.
Implement deterministic supported checkpoint serialization and strict restore validation of schema, operation state, message history, pending events, ownership, location and claims.
Add executable positive, negative, conservation, tie, duplicate/reorder/delay, compensation, horizon and checkpoint/restart tests from ADR-0012.
Run focused tests, core Clippy and workspace formatting; record hashes and results.

verification.oracle: Transfer lifecycle, negative, conservation, compensation and checkpoint/restart oracles pass.
All careops-core targets pass Clippy with warnings denied.

acceptance: Every envelope is versioned and bound to an operation ID, message ID, revision and virtual tick; invalid schema/input rejects before partial mutation.
Normal, rejected, cancelled, expired, duplicate, reordered, delayed, horizon and compensation paths conserve person, episode, location, owner and exclusive claims.
Deadline equality expires request/offer/reservation before later actions, while in-transit expiry at arrival preserves the hold and converts it once to occupancy.
Checkpoint/restart preserves deterministic continuation and deduplication; malformed or incompatible checkpoint rejects fail-closed.
No exactly-once network, clinical policy, ED schema, Kairos source/pin or new dependency claim.
stop_conditions: Unresolvable ambiguity in owner or resource conservation
A required checkpoint state cannot be represented without dropping claims
Focused oracle cannot be made deterministic
